purpose: Independent software verification. This plan does not establish clinical, pathological, biological, or prospective model validity.
independence: Separate implementation roles within one assistant team; not an independent laboratory or third-party certification. Fixtures specified before the first benchmark run.
fault_families: exact declared content digest shared across train and test
known identity group shared across train and test without exact duplicate bytes
heuristic episode shared across train and test, without claiming identity
conflicting labels within identical content digests
digest malformed or digest disagrees with actual file bytes
prediction label disagrees with manifest label
clean_controls: unique digests, disjoint groups and train/test members
same bare group name in different collections, namespaces absent
same group string with distinct identity versus episode kinds
identical labels without any duplicate or group overlap
missing group evidence must be unknown rather than proved clean
unknown labels must not be replaced by inferred class labels
sampling_oracles: draws always index existing input records
same seed and input reproduce exact index sequence
all manifest groups represented in exposure diagnostics including zero draw groups
group exposure CV uses population SD over all eligible groups
large-draw equal-group sampler tends to uniform group frequency while image sampler follows group sizes
metrics_oracles: independently computed confusion matrix and balanced accuracy
source-collection scoping prevents incorrect joins of duplicate bare sample IDs
group bootstrap is unavailable without sufficient explicit group evidence
observed prediction outputs can be replayed without training or target-model selection
real_cases: Previously archived JIC/Holeta wheat image inventory and published-model prediction tables; retrospective replay only, no new field collection
COIL-20 processed original images, 1,440 files with 20 photographed object IDs; object identity audit only, not disease validation or mandatory known-object classification split policy
baselines: Self-written namespace-aware group-only detector, explicitly identified
Actual Deepchecks TrainTestSamplesMix if import and compatible installation complete; unavailable results must not be represented as executed
comparison_unit: Property-specific detection and matched clean-control false alarms; not an invented aggregate ML accuracy contest or universal superiority claim
unresolved_evidence: Dataset label correctness and pathological diagnosis
Actual plant/leaf identity absent from wheat metadata
Generalization to other laboratories or field cohorts
Public immutable software release and license authorization
